term.title: crystal lattice defect
term.longtitle: IUPAC Gold Book - crystal lattice defect

definitions.text: Interruption to the regular pattern of atomic arrangement in crystal lattices.

notes.1: In this context, the terms are commonly shortened to "defect".

sources: PAC, 2012, 85, 463. 'Terminology for aggregation and self-assembly in polymer science (IUPAC Recommendations 2013)' on page 468 (https://doi.org/10.1351/PAC-REC-12-03-12)
